# S61 — Fix the five failing NavigationTest tests on the managed device

**Findings:** S55 ran `./gradlew pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest` on `aosp-atd`: 29 tests, 5 failures, all in `NavigationTest`. · **Size:** S · **Tree:** ui

**Not in this slice:** adding new instrumented tests, changing the `instrumented` CI job or the `pixel6api34` device from S55, and running on more than one API level.

## Why

- S55's `instrumented` CI job runs the `androidTest` suite on a Gradle Managed Device. It stays red until these five `NavigationTest` tests pass.
- Three fail on assertions. `assertTextContains` defaults to `substring = false`, so one text item on the node must equal the expected string.
- Two fail with `RootViewWithoutFocusException` from `Espresso.pressBack`.

## Files

- `app/src/androidTest/java/com/squalor/consecutor/NavigationTest.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/EntryEditorDialog.kt`, `ui/TrackerDetailScreen.kt`, `MainScreen.kt` (only if a fix has to change them)

## Failing tests

Instrumented tests in `NavigationTest`, all failing on `pixel6api34`:
- `editingTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation`: `performTextInput(" edited")` runs at selection 0 on the prefilled name, so `EditableText` is ` editedNavigation tracker` and no item equals ` edited`.
- `entryFieldsSurviveRecreation`: a new COUNT entry prefills Value with `1`, so `performTextInput("42")` produces `421`. Passing sibling tests use `performTextReplacement`.
- `selectedTrackerSurvivesRecreation`: `onNodeWithText("Navigation tracker")` finds 2 nodes on the detail screen (top bar title and the `headlineSmall` text in the detail card).
- `backFromDetailReturnsToDashboard` and `backFromSettingsReturnsToDashboard`: `Espresso.pressBack` waits 10 seconds and throws `RootViewWithoutFocusException` (`has-window-focus=false`). Clicks, text entry and `scenario.recreate()` complete in the other tests on the same image.

## Implement

1. Fix the two text-input tests so they replace the prefilled value (`performTextReplacement`) and assert the string they actually expect.
2. Resolve the duplicate name node in `selectedTrackerSurvivesRecreation`.
3. Find why the application window has no focus for the two `pressBack` tests on the `aosp-atd` image, and fix it.
4. Do not change `systemImageSource` in `app/build.gradle`.
